tooltip.hemomancy.water_sigil.desc: ● Summons pure waters from the depths of the world
tooltip.hemomancy.lava_sigil.desc: ● Summons the fiery blood of the earth
tooltip.hemomancy.drainage_sigil.desc: ● Evaporates all liquids within a radius of 4 blocks
tooltip.hemomancy.air_sigil.desc: ● Grants the speed of wind and the swiftness of a whirlwind
tooltip.hemomancy.magnetism_sigil.desc: ● Draws everything lying down to itself with an invisible force, within a radius of 12 blocks
tooltip.hemomancy.resistance_sigil.desc: ● Envelops in armor of condensed crimson blood
tooltip.hemomancy.movement_sigil.desc: ● Moves even the heaviest elements with the force of crimson power
tooltip.hemomancy.teleposition_sigil.des: ● Remembers the moment between moments. To reset the recording [RMB + SHIFT]
tooltip.hemomancy.grow_sigil.desc: ● Envelops flora in a 5 block radius with fertilizer
message.hemomancy.not_owner: §cThe blood in this item is not yours - it rejects you
research.hemomancy.hemomancy_origins.des: In ancient times, when the veil between worlds was thin, five crimson mages discovered the power hidden in the flow of life through blood.
This forbidden art — Hemomancy — allows one to command life essence, bending it to creation, destruction and transcendence. But every drop spilled draws the gaze of the abyss.
The Book is your guide and vessel of knowledge, unlocked through rituals. Place it near the Mage Statue to receive visions of trials that raise your crimson level.
Begin your journey by crafting the Book and seeking the Statue’s guidance. Only through sacrifice will you rise from mortal to archmage.
research.hemomancy.crimson_mage_path.des: The Mage Statue serves as a conduit to the ancient council of crimson mages. It bestows trials of blood and will, rewarding completion with elevation of your mage level.
Each new level unveils deeper secrets — from simple essence manipulation to summoning infernal entities.
Craft the statue from resonant stones infused with your own essence. Place it in a sacred space to begin receiving quests.
Trials may demand the sacrifice of creatures, creation of arcane artifacts, or journeys into demonic realms.
At the highest levels you approach transcendental power, where blood becomes the very fabric of reality.
research.hemomancy.life_essence.name: Essence of Life
research.hemomancy.life_essence.title: Essence of Life
research.hemomancy.life_essence.desc1: Life Points are the currency of Hemomancy, drawn from blood itself. The Sacrificial Dagger extracts your own essence, converting vitality into raw power.
research.hemomancy.life_essence.desc2: Use it with care — overuse invites corruption, a darkening of the soul that amplifies strength yet risks possession.
research.hemomancy.life_essence.desc3: Craft the dagger using crimson steel and glyphs of sacrifice.
research.hemomancy.life_essence.desc4: Later you will harvest essence from creatures and rituals, but every life taken echoes in the void.
research.hemomancy.blood_altar_foundatio: The Blood Altar is the heart of Hemomancy — a forge where life essence is transmuted into items of power. Begin with the basic Tier 1 pedestal.
Infuse it with your blood to awaken it.
Add runes around the altar to increase speed and capacity.
Incorporate resonant materials; corners now contribute to the structure.
Bind demonic glyphs for infernal enhancements.
Embed transcendental crystals; the altar now pulses with otherworldly energy.
Crown it with the highest infernal glyphs and chimeric runes — potential becomes limitless.
With the altar complete, craft blood orbs and runes to bind your soul network.
research.hemomancy.blood_orbs.name: Blood Orbs: Vessels of the Soul
research.hemomancy.blood_orbs.title: Blood Orbs: Vessels of the Soul
research.hemomancy.blood_orbs.desc1: Blood Orbs store life essence within your soul network, essential for fueling sigils and rituals.
research.hemomancy.blood_orbs.desc2: Each tier demands greater sacrifice and rarer materials, binding more tightly to your essence.
research.hemomancy.blood_orbs.desc3: The Apprentice Orb expands capacity, enabling early sigils such as Air for flight.
research.hemomancy.blood_orbs.desc4: Magician and Master Orbs unlock advanced alchemy and demonic summoning.
research.hemomancy.blood_orbs.desc5: Archmage and Transcendental Orbs grant near-divine power over reality through blood.
research.hemomancy.blood_orbs.desc6: The Inexhaustible Orb defies all limits, yet invites eternal corruption.
research.hemomancy.glyphs_of_power.name: Glyphs of Crimson Power
research.hemomancy.glyphs_of_power.title: Glyphs of Crimson Power
Demonic Evolution
research.hemomancy.glyphs_of_power.desc1: Glyphs are etched symbols channeling life essence into potent effects. Blank Glyphs form the base, infused upon the altar.
research.hemomancy.glyphs_of_power.desc2: Fortified and Crimson Glyphs bolster durability and potency for intricate rituals.
research.hemomancy.glyphs_of_power.desc3: Filled, Demonic, and Infernal Glyphs summon hellish forces, but tread carefully to avoid soul corruption.
research.hemomancy.alchemy_mastery.name: Mastery of Crimson Alchemy
research.hemomancy.alchemy_mastery.title: Mastery of Crimson Alchemy
Infusing the Codex
Alchemical Secrets
research.hemomancy.alchemy_mastery.desc1: The Alchemy Table transmutes materials with life essence, birthing sigils and tools of power.
research.hemomancy.alchemy_mastery.desc2: It bridges blood and matter, vital for advanced creations.
research.hemomancy.alchemy_mastery.desc3: Craft the table from resonant woods and crimson ornaments.
research.hemomancy.alchemy_mastery.desc4: Upgrade the Book upon the table to awaken divination abilities: gaze upon essence networks, altar structures, and veiled rituals — your conduit akin to ancient sigils of foresight.
research.hemomancy.alchemy_mastery.desc5: Mastery unveils transmutations that command elements, from fluid waters to molten lava.
Runes augment the altar: Speed hastens crafting, Sacrifices amplify yields from offerings.
Blank Runes are etched with essence for tailored effects.
Capacity and Resonant Capacity swell storage; Relations weave altars into unified networks.
Chimeric Runes fuse all effects into one, achieving ultimate efficiency.
Employ Rune Stairs and Slabs for elegant altar designs without sacrificing function.
research.hemomancy.sigils_of_command.des: Sigils are portable incantations fueled by life essence. Water and Lava summon fluids; Drainage banishes them.
They bind to your orb, drawing from the soul network.
Air grants flight, Magnetism draws items near, Resistance bestows resilience.
Movement relocates blocks, Teleposition whisks you afar, Grow nurtures flora swiftly.
research.hemomancy.crimson_artifacts.des: Crimson Steel Ingots are forged from blood-tempered iron, the foundation for superior tools.
Ornaments adorn altars, heightening their resonances.
Fashion ornaments from steel for both beauty and amplified function.
These crystals harbor pure essence, integral to exalted altars and orbs for warping reality.
research.hemomancy.desecrated_arsenal.de: Desecrated tools are weapons forged in blood: Pickaxe, Axe, Sword, Shovel — enduring and essence-infused.
They siphon life points for superior mining, combat, and excavation.
Awaken them with infernal wills for sentient traits, such as self-mending or harvesting wills from the slain.
research.hemomancy.transcendental_ascens: At the pinnacle of your level, with the supreme orb and Tier 6 altar, transcend mortality. Invoke the crimson council for judgment.
Attain immortality, though at the forfeiture of your humanity — evolve into a being of pure blood essence.
Erect the apex altar structure. Saturate it with boundless essence to rend the veil asunder.
Reign over realms as a god-mage, yet heed: the abyss eternally returns the stare.
